user: I'm CUS-0004. Transaction TX-0401, 240.00 EUR: the goods never arrived. Which reason code applies? State the transaction ID and amount too. Do not open a dispute.
answer:
What I did
- I checked your account transactions and Verta’s dispute reason-code rules.

What I found
- Transaction ID: TX-0401
- Amount: 240.00 EUR
- Merchant: TechMart Online
- Date & status: 2026-07-20, settled
- Applicable reason code: goods_not_received (this matches "goods never arrived")
- Rule check: the goods_not_received window is 90 days. TX-0401 is 100 days old (2026-07-20 → 2026-10-28), so it falls outside that 90-day window and would be ineligible for a goods_not_received dispute.

What happens next
- As you requested, I did not open a dispute.
- If you want, I can (a) escalate this to a human agent for further review, or (b) send an account statement for this period to your registered email to support any claim with the merchant. Tell me which you prefer.

Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each reason code has a window in days from the transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

Reason code guide
## Choosing a code
The reason code must match what actually happened. A dispute filed under the
wrong code is declined and must be refiled, which may push it past its window.

Payment dispute rules
## Eligibility conditions
A dispute is eligible only if all of the following hold: the reason code is
valid; the transaction status is settled; the transaction date is within the
reason code's window relative to the current date; and no customer-level
restriction applies (for example, an account under compliance review cannot
open new disputes until the review concludes).

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.
